EVERYDAY MEANING OF PRESSURE
====

WHAT YOU WILL LEARN
----
• Explain everyday meaning of pressure in your own words.

INTRODUCTION
----
Around a hardware shop in Nakuru, learners meet science ideas without opening a textbook. Pressure is defined as the force acting normally per unit area. ----
• Pressure is defined as the force acting normally per unit area. Normally here means at a right angle or perpendicularly.

studyPages.title: Formula P Equals F Over A
studyPages.body:
FORMULA P EQUALS F OVER A
====

WHAT YOU WILL LEARN
----
• Explain formula p equals f over a in your own words.
• Give a real Kenyan example that shows formula p equals f over a.
• Avoid a common mistake learners make about formula p equals f over a.

INTRODUCTION
----
Around Marikiti market in Nairobi, learners meet science ideas without opening a textbook. Pressure can also be measured in Pascal (Pa) where. This page explains formula p equals f over a so you can recognise it, name it correctly, and use it safely.

MAIN NOTES
----
• Pressure is the force acting normally (perpendicularly) on a unit area.
• The formula is P = F / A, where P is pressure, F is force in newtons (N), and A is area in square metres (m²).
• The SI unit of pressure is the pascal (Pa). One pascal equals one newton per square metre (N/m²).
• If force stays the same and area gets smaller, pressure increases. If area gets larger, pressure decreases.

WORKED EXAMPLE
----
A delivery helper at Marikiti market in Nairobi pushes a cart with force F = 200 N. The contact area of the boards under the wheels is A = 0.50 m². Pressure P = F / A = 200 / 0.50 = 400 Pa. If the helper switches to a narrower plank with A = 0.20 m² and the same force, P = 200 / 0.20 = 1000 Pa — higher pressure, more sinking on soft ground.

IN EVERYDAY LIFE
----
In everyday life around Marikiti market in Nairobi, you can spot formula p equals f over a when you look carefully at materials, heat, food, tools, or living things. Safety tip: follow teacher and lab rules, protect your eyes when heating, never taste unknown chemicals, and raise the alarm early if you see smoke or fire.

SUMMARY
----
• Pressure is the force acting normally (perpendicularly) on a unit area.
• The formula is P = F / A, where P is pressure, F is force in newtons (N), and A is area in square metres (m²).
• The SI unit of pressure is the pascal (Pa). One pascal equals one newton per square metre (N/m²).
• If force stays the same and area gets smaller, pressure increases. If area gets larger, pressure decreases.

ANSWERS

2. At Marikiti market in Nairobi, the situation shows formula p equals f over a because the materials or process match the definition on this page. First name what you observe. Next link it to the correct scientific idea (including any correct symbol or formula such as H₂O, NaCl, Fe, or P = F / A). Finally say why the correct idea helps you stay accurate or safe.
